hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); S="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/fmt-file.sh"; [ -n "$f" ] && [ -x "$S" ] && "$S" "$f" || true

S="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.agents/hooks/block-destructive.sh"; [ -r "$S" ] || { echo "block-destructive: $S missing or unreadable — cannot vet this command" >&2; exit 2; }; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'block-destructive: jq unavailable — destructive-command guard INACTIVE (see development/tool-bootstrap.md)' >&2; exit 0; }; c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); [ -n "$c" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$c" | sh "$S"

INPUT=$(cat); if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then active=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false'); else case "$INPUT" in *'"stop_hook_active":true'* | *'"stop_hook_active": true'*) active=true ;; *) active=false ;; esac; fi; [ "$active" = 'true' ] && exit 0; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'verify skipped: uv unavailable (run .agents/hooks/ensure-toolchain.sh; see development/tool-bootstrap.md)' >&2; exit 0; }; make verify || exit 2
